author: ichorlev
quote: Graphically, GTA 6 is phenomenal—the level of detail, lighting, and living world are truly impressive. Unfortunately, the restrictions the developers have put in place are completely absurd. There are no prostitutes, you can't steal cars in your own neighborhood, and you can't kill protesters—it's appalling because it kills the romance of the game. The developers need to fix this if they truly want the game to succeed. I'm just another player who requested a refund, and I'll buy it again only if they change this. I don't want to be a good citizen in the game—I want the freedom of past GTA titles back.
